messages:
Noah: FYI billing heatmap shows per-token cost jump for tenant `beta-labs` around 06:30 UTC after quota-aware routing v2.
Asha: Is it total spend or cost/token?
Noah: Cost/token. /chat traffic rerouted x-small -> x-medium; median completion tokens rose ~15%.
Ravi: Could be tokenizer differences or reroute double-counting. Any samples?
Noah: Sample: request rq_20260323_001, prompt 42 tokens, x-small completion 120, x-medium 138.
Ivy: Dashboard aggregates on reported_tokens which currently records both initial and final routing writes. We should aggregate by final_decision_id.
Ravi: We emit decision_id in quota_action events but billing pipeline didn't carry it downstream. I'll patch billing to dedupe by final_decision_id.
Asha: Quick mitigation: spike an overlay on tenant card showing median completion tokens last24h vs prev24h and flag >10% delta. I'll feature-flag it for finance first.
devops-bot: Canary: dashboard/spotcheck-overlay -> canary at 2026-03-23T10:00Z.
Ivy: SQL to find dups: SELECT decision_id, COUNT(*) FROM billing_events WHERE tenant='beta-labs' AND ts > '2026-03-23' GROUP BY decision_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1; returned ~3k dupe ids.
Ravi: PR to billing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/511 (use final_decision_id, 30s dedupe window).
Noah: Action items: Asha add overlay + explain doc, Ravi patch billing, Ivy spec tokenizer normalization, monitor tenants with >10% delta and notify finance. Reopen if new tenants pop up.
